# Plugin.Maui.BluetoothManager

High-level Bluetooth Low Energy device connection manager for .NET MAUI on Android and iOS. Scan, connect, read, write, notify, auto-reconnect, timeouts, retries, permissions, RSSI, and adapter lifecycle.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.BluetoothManager
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.BluetoothManager
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-bluetooth-manager
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android, iOS. Mac Catalyst and Windows are not primary targets.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.BluetoothManager

Registration: `UseBluetoothManager` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I connect a MAUI app to a Bluetooth printer / POS / medical device?
- BLE connection manager with auto-reconnect and timeout
- Scan, connect, read, write, and notify without writing Android GATT / CoreBluetooth
- Bluetooth adapter state and permission handling in .NET MAUI

## Do not use when

- You need classic Bluetooth SPP / RFCOMM
- You want a low-level GATT explorer (use Plugin.BLE or Shiny.BluetoothLE)
- Windows or Mac Catalyst is a first-class target
